subject.title: [Bug]:  cron scheduled wake to main session is skipped (status=skipped, error="disabled"), so the main agent is never woken

question: Which linked fix path should own the disabled main-session cron wake semantics for this issue?
rationale: Both open PRs reference this issue but make different choices about bypassing heartbeat enablement versus preserving queued events after a disabled skip; that compatibility and delivery semantics choice should be made by a human reviewer.

options.title: Select and land one linked fix
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101584 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101668, choose the semantics that should become canonical, and land the selected PR after proof.

options.title: Request a replacement
options.body: Close or redirect both candidate PRs if neither preserves the intended heartbeat-disabled and event-delivery contract, then ask for one narrower replacement.

options.title: Defer without new work
options.body: Keep the issue open but leave both candidate PRs unmerged while maintainers gather more live proof of the desired behavior.

recommendation.title: Select and land one linked fix
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101584 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101668, choose the semantics that should become canonical, and land the selected PR after proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh authored the closest merged disabled-heartbeat cron fix and is the best routing candidate for deciding how the recurring case should relate to the one-shot semantics.
